## Call sites of `makeLocalApiRequest`

Besides the definition file, there are 3 files with direct calls (5 call sites total), all missing the new required third `options` argument:

1. **`packages/web-core/src/shared/lib/api.ts`** — 4 call sites (lines 127, 1013, 1038, 1067)
2. **`packages/web-core/src/shared/hooks/useWorkspaces.ts`** — 1 call site (line 97)
3. **`packages/remote-web/src/shared/hooks/useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts`** — 1 call site (line 28)

## Package impact

- **`@vibe/web-core`** owns `api.ts` and `useWorkspaces.ts`, so `pnpm --filter @vibe/web-core run check` fails directly.
- **`@vibe/local-web`** maps its `@/*` alias to `../web-core/src/*` (source-level, not a built dist), and imports `api.ts`/`useWorkspaces.ts` transitively (e.g. via `Bootstrap.tsx`, `ConfigProvider.tsx`), pulling the broken files into its own `tsc` program.
- **`@vibe/remote-web`** has the same `@/*` → web-core source alias, owns `useRelayWorkspaceHostHealth.ts` directly, and also transitively imports `api.ts` (e.g. via `Bootstrap.tsx`, `RemoteAppShell.tsx`, several pages).
- `@vibe/ui` has no references to `makeLocalApiRequest`, `api.ts`, or `useWorkspaces.ts`, so it's unaffected.
